demo_select: SELECT TOP (:top) * FROM dbo.ESP_SOAP_LOG WHERE status = :status ORDER BY id DESC
demo_insert: INSERT INTO dbo.ESP_SOAP_LOG (name, status, created_at) VALUES (:name, :status, GETDATE())
demo_update: UPDATE dbo.ESP_SOAP_LOG SET status = :status WHERE id = :id
material_tag_print_query: SELECT Id,TagNo,MaterialCode,SkuName,Brand,Spec,Material,Count,Unit,BatchNo,Supplier,WarehouseCode,LocationCode,ReceiveDate,PrintCount,LastPrintAt,PrintStatus FROM mat_material_tag WHERE IsDeleted = 0 AND TagNo LIKE :TagNo AND LastPrintAt >= :StartTime AND LastPrintAt < :EndTime AND PrintStatus = :Status ORDER BY LastPrintAt DESC
